up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728575'. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include compounds that have a recorded structure (canonical SMILES not null). The document is identified in the docs table by chembl_id. The association between document and compound occurs via compound_records: compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id and compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Compound structures are linked via molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Return one row per distinct compound. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728575' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
